worst_point_feasible.note: This cover-min point is FEASIBLE (not excluded). Its rigorous dual LB at N=8000,bn=40 is 0.3808 (rises monotonically with N: 0.37979@N4000 -> 0.3808@N8000 -> 0.38104@N12000-primal). The cover's transferred value 0.3805985 there is BELOW the true mu => valid conservative LB.

method: RIGOROUS active-center-pruned adaptive subdivision over the FULL box (p in [0,1], NOT restricted to a feasible sub-region). cover=max_c Phi_c via path_b_analytical.dual_objective_shift, anchor=primal-1e-5. Per-subbox L_max computed only over centers that can possibly be active (a center is dropped iff grid_max_c + L_c*half_diag < env_grid_min - L_keep*half_diag, i.e. provably below the envelope minus kept Lipschitz slack everywhere in the subbox -- a rigorous exclusion from the Lipschitz constant, NOT from the cover). Recursively split longest dimension until per-subbox eps<5e-4 (deep recheck: 2e-4).

infeasibility_rigor_note: High-p corner (p>=0.7) is robustly infeasible at >=7 distinct interior points. However CLARABEL does NOT emit an explicit Farkas/dual-ray certificate (status string only). RIGOR LEVEL = empirical-robust-multipoint, NOT a certified primal-infeasibility ray. CRITICALLY: this verdict does NOT depend on infeasibility exclusion -- the certified floor 0.3809 holds over the FULL box including the infeasible region (where the cover is ~0.41, far above target). Infeasibility is reported only to characterize the region.
subdivision_note: The candidate's small reported L_max~0.46/eps_grid~1.5e-3 vs the plain cover's L_max=7.72 is explained: one outlier center (R8_h0.08_c0.4_q0.25, Phi=-1.28 at the binding point, 1.66 below the cover) inflates the GLOBAL Lipschitz constant but is provably never active near the floor. Dropping it (and other provably-dominated centers) from the Lipschitz constant is rigorous. With active-center pruning the binding-region L_keep is ~0.14, eps<2e-4 after adaptive subdivision, and the certified floor lands at 0.3809 -- ABOVE both the claimed 0.380554 and the target 0.3802838. The raw cover grid_min over the full box (no eps) is 0.3805981 with ZERO grid points below 0.3802838.
verification_independence: Re-derived the floor from scratch (own pruned-Lipschitz adaptive subdivision) without using the missing R7 driver script; cross-validated the cover against fresh SDP dual-LB solves at the binding point (N up to 12000).
